name: Vulkan-Headers
integrityProvenance: SHA256 of received official source archive addressed by the verified Khronos Git commit/tag, not a claim of a separately published release checksum
license: Apache-2.0 OR MIT (original license files preserved)
scope: Windows native EGL/Vulkan hardware device classification and selection only; headers, not a linked Vulkan/WebGPU implementation
reason: The existing read-only Skia/ANGLE Windows SDK has no Vulkan headers. Use the maintained declared VkPhysicalDeviceProperties ABI rather than guessed stack structs or FFI.
